scenarios.name: MDETERM rejects blank at coordinate 1
evidence: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/functions/mdeterm-function: numeric square arrays; blank/text and nonsquare matrices produce #VALUE!.
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/excel.worksheetfunction.minverse: numeric square matrices; blank/text produce #VALUE!, noninvertible matrices produce #NUM!.

Typed reference probes with LibreOffice 26.2.6.3 establish invalid-member rejection before embedded errors and first row-major error among otherwise numeric members. Array-literal error imports are not used as the precedence oracle.
